title: CE39004: Design Sessional
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Complete Design project on a building complex covering various aspects of Civil
Engineering; Complete planning of the complex â Architectural plans, Elevations
and sections, structural design of the complex, Structural detailing of the
complex, Water supply system for each component of the complex with appropriate
provisions of overhead water tanks for supply of water, Sewerage system, Road
network in and around the complex

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper
